overview: Torque Fit is a comprehensive gym and fitness app with a personalized AI diet coach, AI gym mentor, sport-specific AI coaches, a calorie camera that logs meals from real food data, workout tracking, a rank system, challenges with rewards, and a friends system.
features: Personalized AI diet coach and gym mentor based on weight, age, gender, and goals
Sport-specific AI coaches for cricket, football, and more
Calorie camera that captures meal photos and logs calories and macros from real food data
Workout tracking with exercise, sets, reps, and weight history
Rank system with XP and named tiers
Friends system to connect with other users
